title: Organoid-based drug screening identifies homoharringtonine as a therapeutic agent for anaplastic thyroid cancer via TFEB-mediated lysosomal dysfunction.
authors: Zhang, Xinyue; Li, Zhihui; Liu, Jiaye; Huang, Rui
one_liner_zh: 该文通过类器官药物筛选发现高三尖杉酯碱经TFEB介导溶酶体功能障碍治疗甲状腺癌，虽涉及转录因子TFEB但非TF-DNA互作核心，且方法以药物筛选和转录组为主，仅含分子对接，与课题匹配度低。
abstract: PURPOSE: Anaplastic thyroid cancer (ATC) is a rare but aggressive malignancy with unmet clinical needs for novel therapeutic agents. Most prior studies have relied on limited ATC cell lines, which fail to recapitulate tumor heterogeneity. This study aimed to discover novel agent for ATC via patient-derived organoid (PDO)-based drug screening and investigate the underlying therapeutic mechanism. METHODS: Drug screening was performed on ATC organoids using a drug library of stem cell differentiation compounds. RNA-sequencing identified pathway-level mechanisms, while structure-based molecular docking prioritized target proteins. RESULTS: Using a library of stem cell differentiation compounds, we identified homoharringtonine (HHT) as a potent inhibitor for ATC growth in vitro and in vivo. Mechanistically, this effect was mediated by lysosomal dysfunction, which blocked autophagosome-lysosome fusion and triggered cytotoxicity. Furthermore, HHT exhibited high affinity for the PI3K p110 subunit, activating the PI3K-AKT-mTOR pathway to phosphorylate transcription factor EB, retaining it in the cytoplasm and thereby inhibiting lysosomal biogenesis. CONCLUSION: Our study demonstrates the utility of cancer organoids in drug discovery and identifies HHT as a promising therapeuticagent for ATC.
abstract_zh: 目的：甲状腺未分化癌（ATC）是一种罕见但侵袭性强的恶性肿瘤，对新治疗药物存在未满足的临床需求。既往多数研究依赖于有限的ATC细胞系，无法充分反映肿瘤异质性。本研究旨在通过基于患者来源类器官（PDO）的药物筛选，发现针对ATC的新型药物，并探讨其潜在治疗机制。方法：使用干细胞分化化合物药物库对ATC类器官进行药物筛选。RNA测序识别通路水平机制，而基于结构的分子对接则优先确定靶蛋白。结果：利用干细胞分化化合物库，我们鉴定出高三尖杉酯碱（HHT）作为ATC体外和体内生长的强效抑制剂。机制上，该效应由溶酶体功能障碍介导，阻断自噬体-溶酶体融合并触发细胞毒性。此外，HHT对PI3K p110亚基表现出高亲和力，激活PI3K-AKT-mTOR通路以磷酸化转录因子EB，使其滞留于细胞质中，从而抑制溶酶体生物发生。结论：本研究展示了癌症类器官在药物发现中的实用性，并确定HHT为ATC的一种有前景的治疗药物。
